question: Which Swedish athlete won the Laureus Sportsman of the Year 2025 for his world record-breaking performances in pole vault?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mondo Duplantis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Armand "Mondo" Duplantis** is a **Swedish-American** athlete who competes for **Sweden** and is widely considered the greatest **pole vaulter** in the history of the sport.
 
• He is recognized for his extraordinary **world record-breaking performances**, having broken the world record multiple times throughout his career. In **April 2024**, he set a new world record of **6.24 meters** at the **Diamond League** meeting in **Xiamen**, **China**.
 
• The **Laureus World Sportsman of the Year** award is a prestigious global honor given to the male athlete who has demonstrated supreme athletic achievement. Duplantis has been a frequent nominee and winner in various categories due to his dominance in track and field.
 
• His accolades include winning the **Gold Medal** at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics** and securing titles at the **World Athletics Championships** in **2022** (Eugene) and **2023** (Budapest).
 
• His ability to consistently improve his own records by small increments (the **"Bubka"** method) has made him a standout figure in global sports, leading to his selection for the **2025** cycle honors based on his **2024** season performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Laureus World Sports Awards:**
 
 
• Established in **1999** by founding patrons **Daimler** and **Richemont**, these awards celebrate the highest sporting achievements of the year.
 
• The first ceremony was held in **2000** in **Monte Carlo**, with **Tiger Woods** winning the first Sportsman of the Year award.
 
• The winners are selected by the **Laureus World Sports Academy**, which consists of over **70 sporting legends**.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Athletes:**
 
 
• **Karsten Warholm**: A **Norwegian** athlete who holds the world record in the **400-meter hurdles** (**45.94 seconds**). He is a multiple-time **World Champion** and **Olympic Gold medalist**.
 
• **Jakob Ingebrigtsen**: A **Norwegian** middle-distance runner who won **Olympic Gold** in the **1500 meters** at the **Tokyo Games** and holds several world and European records in the **1500m**, **2000m**, and **5000m**.
 
• **Armand Traoré**: A former professional **footballer** who played as a defender for clubs such as **Arsenal**, **Juventus**, and **Queens Park Rangers**. He represented **Senegal** at the international level and is not associated with pole vaulting.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **World Records:** **Mondo Duplantis** has broken the world record **eight times** (as of early **2024**). He first broke the record in **February 2020** in **Torun**, **Poland**, with a jump of **6.17 meters**, surpassing **Renaud Lavillenie**.
 
• **Nationality:** Although born and raised in the **United States** (Louisiana), Duplantis chose to represent his mother's home country, **Sweden**, in international competitions starting in **2015**.
 
• **Technique:** His success is attributed to a combination of elite **sprinting speed** (learned from his father, a former vaulter) and exceptional **gymnastic control**.
 
• **Consistency:** In the **2024** season, his performance in **Xiamen** was particularly notable as it was his first outdoor competition of the year, where he cleared **6.24 meters** on his first attempt.
